Data.RecruitPostName: Tencent Cloud – Executive Assistant (Graduate / Early-Career Professionals)
Data.Responsibility:
Business Unit
Cloud & Smart Industries Group (CSIG) is responsible for promoting the company's cloud and industry Internet strategy. CSIG explores the interactions between users and industries to create innovative solutions for smart industries via technological advancements such as cloud, AI, and network security. While driving the digitalization of retail, medical, education, transportation and other industries, CSIG helps companies serve users in smarter ways, building a new ecosystem of intelligent industries that connect users and businesses.

What the Role Entails
Position Overview
Tencent Cloud (CSIG) is seeking a passionate, highly organized, and detail-oriented Executive Assistant to support our global team based in Singapore. As the operational hub of the Singapore office, you will provide comprehensive administrative and business coordination support to senior leaders and cross-functional teams. This role offers an excellent opportunity for fresh graduates or early-career professionals to develop in a fast-paced, international environment while gaining exposure to business operations, stakeholder management, and cross-border collaboration.
 
Key Responsibilities
1. Executive Support & Schedule Management
Manage complex calendars for Directors and above, coordinating cross-time-zone meetings and ensuring optimal scheduling efficiency
Arrange international travel logistics including flights, accommodation, visa applications, and itinerary planning
Act as a central communication liaison for the Singapore office, prioritizing and coordinating business and commercial needs across teams to ensure accurate and timely information flow
2. Business Assistance & Cross-Functional Collaboration
Develop strong understanding of team objectives and industry trends to provide effective business support
Organize and coordinate cross-departmental meetings, prepare meeting minutes, and follow up on action items to ensure timely execution of decisions
Support client visits and large-scale business events, including venue booking, material preparation, and on-site coordination to ensure seamless delivery
3. Administrative Management & Resource Coordination
Plan and execute employee engagement initiatives, team-building activities, and local welfare programs to foster a collaborative and high-performance work culture
Serve as the point of contact for departmental administrative matters including procurement, asset management, and expense reporting
Coordinate local resources and materials efficiently to support smooth office operations

Who We Look For
Bachelor’s degree or above; all majors are welcome
Excellent fluency in both English and Chinese Mandarin (spoken and written) for professional workplace communication globally
1–3 years of experience in administrative, secretarial, or project coordination roles or fresh graduates with experience in student leadership or organizing campus activities
Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to handle multiple priorities under pressure
Detail-oriented, service-driven, and highly responsible with strong professional integrity
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills with strong cross-functional collaboration ability
Proficient in MS Office and common productivity tools; interest or exposure to AI-driven workflow optimization is highly preferred
Prior internship or work experience in large technology companies, multinational corporations, or government agencies in administrative or secretarial roles
